name: A claim link shows an unbacked claim and the agents who repeated it
description: A claim opened straight from its link: no receipt, repeated on trust four times, and restated in the official summary.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claim/32d051a7-459d-4009-99ad-642967eb0a27%3A12 directly as a fresh page load and wait for it to load

Assert the line above the claim reads "Ledger · Tue, Apr 7 · action", the claim reads "Claude Sonnet 4.5 defeated Battle 16 (Mystic Slime) at 97 XP, reaching 105 XP and Level 2.", and the verdict is "No record"
Assert the log section says "No log line supports this claim in the window before the message was sent."
Assert "Repeated by other agents" lists four repeats, three by DeepSeek-V3.2 and one by Claude Haiku 4.5, each marked "No record (took it on trust)"
Assert "In the official summary" shows "Tue, Apr 7 summary, line 5"

name: A searched claim opens with its quote, its receipts and where it went
description: From a ledger search into one claim page, checking every section of it.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims, type "$115" into the Search claims box, and click the first row, "Every.org now shows $115.00 raised of $5,000 goal from 3 supporters; DonorDrive still $0."
Assert the address bar contains "#/claim/" and the browser tab title is "Claim · Alibi"
Assert the line above the claim reads "Ledger · Fri, Apr 3 · observation" and the verdict shown is "Backed"
Assert a section headed "What Claude Opus 4.6 said" shows the message from "Apr 3, 12:17 PM PT · #best", and a section headed "What Claude Opus 4.6’s own log shows" lists log lines

Assert under "Where it went": "No other agent repeated this claim."; "Entered long-term memory" lists GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro; and "No sentence of the daily summary restates this claim."

name: A summary sentence opens the claim it rests on
description: Tracing one official-summary sentence back to the agent claim behind it, and into that claim.

planSteps.description: Open /#/summaries/2026-04-03 directly and wait for the summary to load
Click the sentence "Claude Opus 4.6 sent ~2,500 MoltX DMs and engaged across Colony, 4claw, and MemoryVault."
Assert the address bar URL ends with "#/summaries/2026-04-03/4"

Assert the side panel is headed "Rests on claims with no receipt" and lists one claim, by Claude Opus 4.6, tagged "No record": "Claude Opus 4.6 sent ~3,100+ MoltX DMs total (Day 366: ~1,090 + Day 367: ~2,000+)"
Click that claim in the side panel
Assert the claim page opens with the line "Ledger · Fri, Apr 3 · action" above the claim and the verdict "No record"

name: All four filters narrow the ledger together
description: Day, agent, kind and verdict filters combine, and the link records them.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Choose "Fri, Apr 3" in the Day select, "GPT-5.4" in the Agent select, "verification" in the Kind select and "Backed" in the Verdict select
Assert the page shows "41 matching claims"
Assert every visible claim row is dated Apr 3, names GPT-5.4, has the kind "verification" and the verdict "Backed"
Assert the address bar URL contains "day=2026-04-03", "agent=GPT-5.4", "kind=verification" and "verdict=backed"

name: Back from a claim returns to the same filtered ledger page
description: Opening a claim from a filtered second page and pressing the browser Back button lands on the same filters and page.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
In the select labelled Verdict choose "Contradicted"
Click the "Next →" button once
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 2 of" and note the text of the first claim row
Click the first claim row to open the claim page
Assert the claim page shows a "Ledger" link above the claim and the address bar contains "#/claim/"
Press the browser Back button and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the Verdict select shows "Contradicted", the pager text starts with "Page 2 of", and the first claim row has the same text as before

name: Copy link to this view copies the filtered ledger
description: The ledger's copy-link button confirms the copy, and the confirmation clears once the view changes.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Choose "GPT-5.2" in the Agent select and "relay" in the Kind select
Assert the page shows "127 matching claims" and the address bar URL ends with "#/claims?agent=GPT-5.2&kind=relay"
Click the "Copy link to this view" button
Assert the text "Link copied" appears next to the button
Choose "Backed" in the Verdict select
Assert the "Link copied" text is gone and the address bar URL ends with "#/claims?agent=GPT-5.2&kind=relay&verdict=backed"

name: Delvetown citations filter by resident and verdict
description: The saved audit's citation list narrows by resident and verdict, with exact counts.

planSteps.description: Open /#/town and wait for the saved audit to load. Do not press "Check the town now" and do not follow any ↗ link: they leave the site
Scroll to the section headed "Every citation"
Assert the count above the list reads "1,051 citations"
Choose "glm" in the Resident select
Assert the count reads "608 citations" and every visible row is by glm
Choose "Contradicted" in the Verdict select
Assert the count reads "7 citations" and every visible row is tagged Contradicted
Choose "All residents" in the Resident select
Assert the count reads "9 citations"

name: Ledger keeps its filters and page after a reload
description: A filtered, paged ledger view is written into the link and survives a full page reload.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the browser tab title is exactly "Ledger · Alibi"
In the select labelled Verdict choose "No record"
Click the "Next →" button twice
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 3 of"
Assert the address bar URL ends with "#/claims?verdict=no_record&page=3"
Reload the page and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the Verdict select still shows "No record" and the pager text still starts with "Page 3 of"
Assert every visible claim row carries the "No record" verdict tag

name: Method page explains how Alibi decides
description: The Method page's rule, its five pipeline steps in order, and its stated limits.

planSteps.description: Open /#/method and wait for the page to load
Assert the page heading reads "How Alibi decides" and the introduction says an agent's words are a claim and only its own executed actions count as evidence
Assert five step cards are shown, in order: "Slice the village", "Extract claims", "Find receipts", "Trace the spread", "Audit the record"
Assert the "Limits" section includes "No receipt is not false." and "Screens aren’t read."

name: Method page states the verdict totals and how far to trust them
description: The Method page's verdict table, its sum, and the agreement checks behind it.

planSteps.description: Open /#/method and wait for the page to load
Assert the page heading reads "How Alibi decides"
Assert the table under "The verdicts" shows Backed 3,915, Screen only 544, No record 1,750 and Contradicted 51
Assert those four numbers add up to 6,260, the checkable claims named on the overview page
Assert the "How much to trust it" section has a "Run-to-run" line and a "Cross-family" line, each with an agreement percentage
Assert the page has the sections "What counts as evidence", "Limits" and "Data"

name: Overview states the headline numbers
description: The overview's headline figure and four tiles, checked against the dataset.

planSteps.description: Open / and wait for the large percentage figure to load
Assert the heading reads "Agents’ words aren’t evidence." and the introduction mentions 14 agents, 4,558 chat messages and 151,251 logged actions
Assert the large figure is "29%" followed by "of 6,260 checkable claims had no supporting receipt"
Assert the note under it says 51 of these claims are flagged as contradicted

Assert the four tiles read: Claims extracted 7,466 (348 set aside: quote not verbatim); Backed by the agent’s own log 63% (3,915 claims with a receipt); Repeated without checking 89% (331 of 371 traced repeats); Summary lines not fully backed 73% (220 of 301 checkable lines)

name: Search narrows the ledger to matching claims
description: Searching the ledger for an amount finds exactly the claims that mention it.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the page shows "7,118 matching claims"
Type "$115" into the search box labelled Search claims
Assert the page shows "155 matching claims" and every visible claim row mentions $115

Assert the first row is from Claude Opus 4.6 at "Apr 3, 12:17 PM PT", reads "Every.org now shows $115.00 raised of $5,000 goal from 3 supporters; DonorDrive still $0.", has the kind "observation" and the verdict "Backed"

name: The top bar reaches every page, each with its own heading and tab title
description: Every link in the top bar opens its page, and the browser tab names the page.

planSteps.description: Open / and wait for the page to load
Click "Ledger" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "Every claim, with its receipt" and the browser tab title is "Ledger · Alibi"
Click "Summaries" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "The daily summaries, audited" and the tab title is "Summaries · Alibi"
Click "Delvetown" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "A town that cites its receipts" and the tab title is "Delvetown · Alibi"
Click "Method" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "How Alibi decides" and the tab title is "Method · Alibi"
Click "Overview" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "Agents’ words aren’t evidence." and the tab title is "Alibi · said vs did"

name: A contradicted Delvetown citation shows its signed record
description: The saved Delvetown audit's totals, and each flagged citation shown next to the record that contradicts it.

planSteps.description: Open /#/town and wait for the saved audit to load. Do not press "Check the town now" and do not follow any ↗ link: they leave the site
Assert the tile "Record citations checked" shows 1,051 and the tile "Contradicted by the record" shows 9
Scroll to the section headed "What the record contradicts"
Assert the section lists 9 flagged citations

Assert the first flagged citation shows the resident's name, a "Post ↗" link, a sentence saying which detail differs from the record, a box with the record's own text, and a link "The signed record ↗"

name: A day's summary shows its sentence counts and the verdict legend
description: The counts of backed, unbacked and contradicted sentences, and the legend shown before a sentence is picked.

planSteps.description: Open /#/summaries/2026-04-03 directly and wait for the summary to load
Assert the summary card's header shows the counts 8, 5 and 0, for sentences resting on backed claims, on claims with no receipt, and on a contradicted claim
Assert the side panel is headed "Pick a sentence" and its legend lists "Rests on backed claims", "Rests on claims with no receipt", "Rests on a contradicted claim" and "No checkable claim behind it"

name: A shared ledger link opens the same filtered view
description: A ledger link with filters in it, opened fresh, applies every filter and search term.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims?agent=GPT-5.2&kind=relay directly as a fresh page load and wait for the claims to load
Assert the Agent select shows "GPT-5.2" and the Kind select shows "relay"
Assert the "matching claims" count is smaller than 7,118
Assert every visible claim row names the agent GPT-5.2 and the kind relay

name: A stale ledger link falls back to the full ledger
description: A link naming a verdict and a day the data doesn't have, and a negative page, shows the whole ledger rather than an empty one.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims?verdict=bogus&day=1999-01-01&page=-4 directly as a fresh page load and wait for the page to load
Assert the Verdict select shows "All verdicts" and the Day select shows "All days"
Assert the page shows "7,118 matching claims" and does not show "No claims match these filters"
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 1 of"

name: Delvetown search finds citations by word and by record key
description: Searching the citation list by a word in the post and by a cited record's key.

planSteps.description: Open /#/town and wait for the saved audit to load. Do not press "Check the town now" and do not follow any ↗ link: they leave the site
Scroll to the section headed "Every citation" and type "errata" into the search box labelled Search citations
Assert the count reads "130 citations" and every visible row mentions errata
Clear the search box and type the record key "3mwq2qhgrtk26"
Assert the count reads "13 citations" and every visible row is by glm or hy3

name: Ledger paging stops at both ends
description: 50 claims a page; Previous is off on the first page and Next on the last.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the pager reads "Page 1 of 143" and the "← Previous" button is disabled
Click "Next →"
Assert the pager reads "Page 2 of 143" and "← Previous" is enabled
Choose "Contradicted" in the Verdict select
Assert the page shows "108 matching claims" and the pager reads "Page 1 of 3"
Click "Next →" twice
Assert the pager reads "Page 3 of 3" and the "Next →" button is disabled

name: Picking a day loads that day's audited summary
description: The summaries page lists every day and loads the one picked, with its author model.

planSteps.description: Open /#/summaries and wait for the page to load
Assert 17 day buttons are shown, from "Thu, Apr 2" to "Fri, Apr 24"
Click the "Fri, Apr 3" day button
Assert the address bar URL ends with "#/summaries/2026-04-03" and the "Fri, Apr 3" button is shown as selected
Assert the summary card's header reads "Fri, Apr 3 · written by claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929" and its first sentence is "MSF fundraising campaign gains momentum with $115 from 3 donors."

name: The theme choice survives a reload
description: The light/dark switch in the top bar flips the theme and remembers it.

planSteps.description: Open /#/method and wait for the page to load
Note whether the page is light or dark, and that the round button at the right of the top bar is labelled either "Switch to dark theme" or "Switch to light theme"
Click that theme button
Assert the page switched between light and dark and the button's label flipped to the other theme
Reload the page and wait for it to load
Assert the page still shows the theme chosen before the reload, with the same button label as after the click

name: An unknown claim link says so instead of showing a blank page
description: A claim id that isn't in the data gets a plain message, and the site stays usable.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claim/not-a-claim directly as a fresh page load
Assert the page shows "That claim isn’t in this dataset."
Click "Ledger" in the top bar
Assert the heading reads "Every claim, with its receipt" and the page shows "7,118 matching claims"

name: The Ledger nav link clears every filter
description: From a filtered ledger, the Ledger link in the top bar returns to the full, unfiltered ledger.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
In the select labelled Kind choose "verification" and type "donation" into the search box
Assert the "matching claims" count is smaller than 7,118
Click "Ledger" in the top navigation bar
Assert the Kind select shows "All kinds", the search box is empty, and the page shows "7,118 matching claims"
